sectionObligations.statement: Separate tenant accounting, inventory valuation, market/public price, purpose allowlist, transaction and snapshot currencies; KZ default KZT, other markets separate approved policy.
Allowed currency is not legal or market admission; KZT-only public KZ price, no automatic B2B exception.
Positive rate and nominal, actual effective date, immutable semantic revisions and atomic whole-batch admission; no silent MOCK fallback.
Fixed trusted HTTPS adapter and bounded parsing; fetch outside DB locks, explicit source provenance and no historical mutation.
One DECIMAL128 formula: multiply anchorAmount by rateKzt before divide nominal; buffer then markup then CEILING step; no pre-rounded normalizedRate.
Post-rounding guardrails, exact boundary comparisons, NO_CHANGE without revision/budget, no clamp or gradual bypass.
Rolling window (t-W,t], baseline as of t-W, absolute variation includes manual revisions, shared tenant budget serialized and no reset by run or midnight.
Price owner revision, receipt and budget consumption atomic; no financial exposure inference from sum of unit-price deltas.
Fresh tenant/warehouse authorization in outer transaction, snapshot resolves source revision, generation and proof coherently.
Closed covered CURRENT L3 else qualified owner-source L0; route reason independent of quality; PARTIAL is not READY; missing not zero.
Closed equal calendar windows, default3, 2..120; match tenant/generation/metric/method/grain/currency/UOM/revision and auth; reject incomplete/incompatible input.
AVG/SMA same fixed window; growth/CV ratios not percent; nonpositive denominator not measurable; OLS slope per ordinal; population SD.
Exact distinct set identity; additive sums separate; SQL/Java numerical tolerance candidate not approved rounding; EMA/forecast separate proof.
Current observation time cannot establish historical availability; no backtest/training/production inference without immutable provenance.
Bounded replay/period refresh; durable progress; fresh independent proof and explicit CAS activation; preserve previous generation.
Homogeneous L0 or same L3 generation/proof for conclusions; abstain on mixed routes, unproved causal hypotheses; no industrial latency claim.
NIGHT and INTRADAY source parity, durable completion, stale lease rejection and recovery; bounded pilot BOOKED_ORDERS only.
Pilot 7 slots/day, <=31 days, <=217 stored requests per tenant; no automatic retention or runtime enablement.
Matched OFF/ON workload per operation, p95 degradation <=10%, p99 <=20%, no deadlock/pool timeout/missed qualified deadline.
Typed allowlisted triggers/conditions, explicit audience and safe versioned template; preview no enqueue; default disabled.
Fresh permission per recipient and on open; separate service/marketing consent, in-app plus mock only; external delivery gate separate.
Owner command and canonical event/required outbox in same PG tx; stable tenant/owner/event identity; no remote I/O under locks.
Independent receipt/effect per consumer, at-least-once transport, bounded lease/generation/retry/replay; no global order.
After P4.1A.5-Q GREEN, owner publication and file attachment/event atomic; external storage verify outside tx; catalog fresh auth independently.
Report lifecycle trigger/provider separate admission; one logical ready notification, separate PDF artifact, no inference from generated/available file.
Scheduled occurrence and deadline separate from analytics job pilot; no report overdue without qualified occurrence.

findings.resolution: Legacy SALES_INTERNAL cannot substitute PRICING_ANCHOR for AUTO; preserve legacy semantics, verify implementation/grants; no activation.

findings.issue: FX design freeze vs implementation foundation
findings.resolution: R2C.0 register authorizes offline foundation, not real publication; later implementation slices require exact owner scope and gates; no general AUTO activation.

findings.issue: Calculation READY vs qualified business result
findings.resolution: Local kernel readiness, L3 proof, source completeness and current authorization are separate; PARTIAL cannot be upgraded by successful calculation.
Closed-window derived metrics not interchangeable with cumulative same-day observations; no period double counting or historical availability inference.
BOOKED_ORDERS bounded analytical pilot is not authorization for general report or FX scheduler; distinct occurrence and owner contracts.
Canonical event, transport ACK, consumer effect, report attachment/published state and notification delivery distinct; no exactly-once end-to-end claim.
Existing EVT-01 candidates exclude reporting triggers until explicit admission; P4.2 producer independent of consumer availability; no new bus.
PostgreSQL numeric vs DECIMAL128 tolerance candidate needs independent parity and approved rounding; no historical model or prediction claim.
